answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with bonded, time-weighted reputation: each identity posts a refundable bond and earns trust only through verified completed work, a lantern lit slowly, never switched on whole. A newcomer starts with zero spending power and tight rate limits, so influence must be grown, not copied. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand work histories, and no gale of freshly minted identities can blow past that cost. On the horizon, only sustained honest work compounds; fraud forfeits the bond.
